summary: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, computer security expert, strong advocate for privacy and anonymity, frequent user of Tor and VPNs, interest in cryptocurrency (especially Bitcoin), active in online communities focused on digital privacy and security, technical expertise in Linux and virtualization, critical of government surveillance and law enforcement practices, engaged in discussions about drug policy and harm reduction, history of mental health challenges (bipolar disorder), no children, identifies as an anarchist and transhumanist.
